name: bush
doc: A shrub (design/systems.md, Shrubs and ground cover): the game asks for a species, age, and season, and whether its berries are still on, at a position with the local wind; grow makes the shrub, and the animator sways it in the same wind as the trees and flowers. No break interaction.

params.name: species
params.doc: A species: one genome from config/bush_genomes/.

params.name: fruit
params.doc: The shrub still carries its berries; clear it when they are picked. Applies only to species whose fruit can be picked (pickable); elsewhere it is disabled.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Which of the distinct shrubs per species, age, and season (the runtime caps how many by quality).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.
